description: This file defines a Java interface FilteredTopicBuilder that provides a fluent API for constructing FilteredTopic objects with methods to set namespaces, filters, and extra fields.

classes.name: FilteredTopicBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface with fluent API for creating FilteredTopic instances, allowing configuration of namespaces, filters, and extra fields.

methods.name: withNamespaces
methods.description: Sets the list of namespaces for the filter. Accepts a collection of strings which can be null, allowing flexible namespace configuration.

methods.name: withFilter
methods.description: Sets an optional RQL filter for the topic. Accepts a nullable CharSequence.

methods.name: withExtraFields
methods.description: Sets extra fields using a JsonFieldSelector to enrich the topic with additional data.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a FilteredTopic based on the current configurations.
